from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyFinancialMetric(BaseModel):
    """Extracted financial metric data from a single company's financial report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company as stated in the report")
    metric_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the financial metric (e.g. '持续经营净利润')")
    value: float | None = Field(description="The numerical value of the metric")
    currency_unit: str | None = Field(description="The currency unit associated with the value (e.g. '元')")
    reporting_period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period covered by this data (e.g. '2024 年第一季度')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    financial_records: list[CompanyFinancialMetric]
